description: The file manages the editing interface for a blocked device within a content control system, handling form display, validation, and AJAX submission for device blocking settings including schedule and days.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes form fields with existing device data, setting up event handlers for UI interactions.

methods.name: updateBlockedTimeVisibility
methods.description: Enables or disables form inputs related to device blocking schedule based on whether 'Always Block' is selected.
